para.dtcname: CAN Bus Short to GND Inspection

content5.ptxt: If the resistance between 6 (CANH), 14 (CANL) and 4 (CG) of DLC3 is below 200 Ω, the CAN bus may be shorted to GND.

entry.ptxt: Resistance between 6 (CANH), 14 (CANL) and 4 (CG) of DLC3 is below 200 Ω

item.ptxt: Instrument Panel Junction Block Assembly (Main Body ECU)

atten4.ptxt: 2WD models equipped with neither pre-crash safety nor radar cruise control have no CAN gateway ECU wiring.

atten3.ptxt: When measuring the resistance of the CAN bus, turn the ignition switch off, check that warning functions such as the key reminder warning system are not operating, and leave the vehicle for at least 1 minutes without operating the key or switches or opening and closing the doors before starting the measurement. If it is necessary to open a door during inspection, open it beforehand.

atten4.ptxt: When disconnecting a connector, check that the connector terminals and connector case are free of damage, deformation, corrosion, etc.
